text: The property whereby the meaning of a complex representation is determined by the meanings of its constituents and the way they are combined -- so that 'John loves Mary' and 'Mary loves John' differ in meaning -- is called ___.
explanation: Compositionality (together with systematicity) is the feature Fodor and Pylyshyn argue requires a language-like, constituent-structured medium of thought and which they charge connectionist networks cannot straightforwardly capture. It is distinct from mere productivity (the capacity to generate indefinitely many thoughts).
